verdict.rationale: sevDesk is a SaaS accounting platform, so an official MCP server is a fair question to ask of it, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions one. The REST API (sevdesk-docs-23) is a developer building block, not an MCP server, so it earns no credit; the probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
